title: Lola's Carriage House
meta_description: Rosemary Beach carriage house with 1 bedroom, 1 bath, king bed & sofa sleeper. Private balcony, kitchenette, steps from beach & pools.
description_expanded: DescriptionWhat Guests Love* 2 complimentary beach cruiser bikes* Private balcony* Very family-friendly atmosphere* A short walk to the Coquina Pool, Eastern Green, and Rosemary Beach* Washer / dryerWelcome to Lola’s Carriage House— a picture-perfect pied-å-terre with a distinctly elegant Rosemary Beach design. The facade of Lola’s Carriage House exudes classic beach house vibes— with tropical Bahamian shutters and a cobblestone driveway. Inside, the cozy, well-designed loft provides tons of storage and comfort in a relatively small space. Best of all, you’ll be conveniently located only a short stroll from the beach, the sparkling Coquina Pool, and charming downtown Rosemary.The main living and dining area is wide open, and the neutral, sandy-toned walls are framed with lots of bright, sunny windows. Custom Bahamian shutters allow for some shade and privacy. In the living area, a plush cream-colored sofa is piled high with colorful throw pillows and pulls out to reveal a comfy sofa bed. A striped side chair and a leather club chair provide additional seating. The built-in entertainment center houses a flatscreen television and also creates a privacy barrier between the living and sleeping spaces.The kitchenette is small but completely capable, with tons of thoughtful storage provided. The kitchenette features a mini-refrigerator, a microwave, an oven, a small sink, and a coffee maker. The circular dining table has seating for four people and is a great spot to sip your morning coffee while reading the newspaper. Or perhaps you’ll want to take your mug outside to the private sun-dappled balcony that overlooks the neighborhood.Around the corner is the sleeping space, complete with a new luxe king-size bed and built-in storage that adds some privacy from the living area, but doesn’t completely close it off. The full bathroom has a step-in shower with a glass door— ideal for rinsing off sun-kissed skin after a day at the beach or pool.Perched on the corner of a charming tree-lined street, this positively adorable apartment home has a premier Rosemary Beach location. Guests of Lola’s Carriage House will be a few short steps from the gorgeous Eastern Green and beach walkover. If you’re in the mood to practice your backstroke, head one block east to the simply stunning Coquina Pool. And when you want to head out for drinks or a delicious dinner, Main Street is a short walk west. Perfect for couples or small families, you’ll quickly fall in love with Lola’s Carriage House.MAIN FLOOR* LIVING AREA with pull-out sofa bed, side chair, club chair, side tables, coffee table, and flatscreen television* DINING TABLE with seating for four people* Open KITCHENETTE with mini-refrigerator, oven, and microwave* SLEEPING SPACE with a king-size bed, storage space, and flatscreen television* BATHROOM with step-in shower* BALCONY with lounge spaceTDT-015340
